Subject: Request: COI + endorsement language for PO staging

Hi Sally,

Thanks for moving ahead with Redwood. Procurement needs a couple of items to stage the PO in our system and get the activation to finance:

- Certificate of Insurance (COI) showing Commercial General Liability and Professional Liability limits.
- Endorsement naming Redwood Inference as additional insured (or an exception/waiver signed by Meridian legal).
- W-9 or tax equivalent for vendor setup.

I've attached our COI requirements summary so you can compare what you already have. If Meridian can't provide the additional insured endorsement, we can take a signed waiver but procurement will need the waiver to be signed by an authorized Meridian rep and approved by our Legal.

Can you share the COI and any endorsement language by end of day Monday? I can loop in Laura (procurement ops) to start the PO as soon as we have the certificate or waiver.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the checklist and the clear ask. Attached is our current COI and a partial W-9 (company is US entity). Meridian's broker provided the COI but they did not include the additional insured endorsement by default.

We have two options from our side:
1) Ask the broker to re-issue the COI with Redwood Inference named as additional insured (takes ~2 business days), or
2) Meridian legal can sign a liability waiver/exception acknowledging the limitation and accepting the coverage as-is — I can send that for signature today.

Which path will work better for Redwood to keep the PO moving? If a waiver is acceptable, who should sign on the Redwood side (procurement or Legal)?

Attached: meridian_coi_20261119.pdf, meridian_partial_w9_20261119.pdf

Best,
Sally Cho

Hi Sally —

Appreciate the quick reply and the attachments. I reviewed the COI and it does not show the additional insured endorsement. We can accept a signed waiver as a temporary measure while the broker issues an endorsed certificate, but we need the waiver to include:

- Statement that Meridian accepts Redwood Inference will not be named additional insured for services under this PO, and
- Meridian legal signatory name, title, and date, and
- Reference to the Redwood PO number once available (we can update after PO creation).

If you can get the waiver signed, please upload the signed PDF here or send back via DocuSign. I've attached our standard waiver template to this thread for convenience. If Meridian prefers to have the broker re-issue the COI with additional insured, that also works — in that case procurement will wait for the endorsed COI and we will proceed with PO creation after confirmation.

For internal clarity: Vivek, once we receive the signed waiver or the endorsed COI, can you approve the PO staging so finance can pick it up?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Procurement Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
